title: Sanctification in Practice: The Battle Against Sin
speaker: Mr. Alex Lyro

outline.title: Sanctification is a Whole-Man Work
subpoints: Involves mind, will, affections, and body
Goal is peace with God through total surrender

outline.title: The Imperfection of Sanctification in This Life
subpoints: Remnants of corruption remain in every part
Sin no longer reigns but still persists
Struggle is not an excuse for complacency

outline.title: The Continual and Irreconcilable War
subpoints: No peaceful coexistence between sin and grace
Discomfort with sin indicates active faith

outline.title: Victory Through the Spirit's Strength
subpoints: Regenerate part overcomes through Christ's supply
Growth in grace and perfecting holiness
Reliance on the Armor of God

summary: This lesson continues the study of Chapter 13 of the Westminster Confession of Faith, focusing on the practical reality of sanctification in the believer's life. The teaching emphasizes that sanctification is a comprehensive work affecting the whole person—spirit, soul, and body—rather than merely a series of external behavioral adjustments. Citing 1 Thessalonians 5:23, the speaker highlights the attribute of God as the 'God of peace,' suggesting that true peace with God is found only when the entire life is surrendered to Christ's lordship.
